name: DescribeIPv6TranslatorEntries

parameters.help_en: The region of the IPv6 Translation Service instance. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例的地域。 您可以通过调用DescribeRegions接口获取地域ID。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the IPv6 Translation Service instance
parameters.name: ipv6_translator_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the IPv6 Translation mapping entry to query. 

If both Ipv6TranslatorId and Ipv6TranslatorEntryId are empty, all IPv6 Translation mapping entries are returned. If only Ipv6TranslatorEntryId is empty, all IPv6 Translation mapping entries under the current IPv6 Translation Service instance are returned
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的IPv6转换映射条目ID。 

如果Ipv6TranslatorId参数和Ipv6TranslatorEntryId参数的值都为空，则返回所有IPv6转换映射条目信息。如果仅是Ipv6TranslatorEntryId参数的值为空，则返回当前IPv6转换服务实例下的所有IPv6转换映射条目信息。
parameters.name: ipv6_translator_entry_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the IPv6 Translation mapping entry
parameters.name: entry_name

parameters.help_en: The IPv6 address allocated by the IPv6 Translation Service instance
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例分配的IPv6地址
parameters.name: allocate_ipv6_addr

parameters.help_en: The port used by the IPv6 address allocated by the IPv6 Translation Service instance
parameters.help_zh: IPv6转换服务实例分配的IPv6地址使用的端口。
parameters.name: allocate_ipv6_port

parameters.help_en: The public IPv4 address that requires IPv6 services
parameters.help_zh: 需要提供IPv6服务的公网IPv4地址
parameters.name: backend_ipv4_addr

parameters.help_en: The port used by the public IPv4 address that requires IPv6 services
parameters.help_zh: 需要提供IPv6服务的公网IPv4地址使用的端口。
parameters.name: backend_ipv4_port

parameters.help_en: The protocol type used for data forwarding
parameters.name: trans_protocol

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable access control. Valid values:
on: enabled.
off: disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启访问控制。取值：
on：开启。
off：不开启
parameters.name: acl_status

parameters.help_en:
The type of the access control policy. Valid values:

white: allows the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group to access backend services.

black: denies the IPv6 addresses in the access control policy group from accessing backend services
parameters.help_zh:
访问控制策略类型。取值：

white：允许访问策略组中的IPv6地址访问后端服务。

black：禁止访问策略组中的IPv6地址访问后端服务
parameters.name: acl_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the access control policy group
parameters.name: acl_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page for paging. Maximum value: 50. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的行数，最大值为50，默认值为10。
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

Generate a parameter value from your client to ensure uniqueness across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token
